The refund window in `backend/app/rules.py` is 30 days (`REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS = 30`). A refund counts as late only when `days > 30`, so a refund exactly 30 days after delivery is still on time. It stops being on time on day 31.

The question asks how many days after delivery a refund stops being on time. I'm reading that as the 30-day window limit, not day 31, the first late day.

ANSWER: 30
